$comment: Template for ~/.cursor/hooks.json — replace REPO_ROOT with this repository's absolute path (merge into an existing hooks.json; Cursor also reads project-level .cursor/hooks.json). cursor-hook.mjs translates Cursor payloads and delegates to the shared membase hook bundle: with a disk login (stdio bundle mode) it captures + flushes in real time; without one (HTTP mode) it still spools captures locally and announces the pending count at session start. MEMBASE_DATA_DIR defaults are set inline; see docs/install/cursor.md.
